title: Band contests: Edwards Collegians, Belton's Syncopators, Cannonball's father
summary: He recalls yearly contests in Chicago and Detroit and Belton's Syncopators, where Cannonball Adderley's father played.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: used to have, every year they used to have a contest - Edwards Collegians, Belton's Syncopators -

They would have the contest in Chicago and Detroit. Detroit was the Greystone Ballroom, of course. Every year and Rex Stewart playing with the Wilberforce Collegians, they would be in it. But Edwards Collegians had 9 pieces and they don't know who won the contest.
Edwards Collegians, Belton's Syncopators out of Florida... Adderly's Cannonball's father was in that. //And they were like this.
What band was Cannonball's father in?
Belton's Syncopators. Belton later on came to New York four doors from Sugar Ray's place and had a barbecue place.
His father? Saxophone. But he was a school teacher. That's the reason Cannonball was a school teacher. He's not an ignorant man; the man taught school.
